name: Rogue
description: A specialist in the unfair advantage. Rogues find the opening nobody else sees, put everything into one precise strike, and are somewhere else entirely by the time it matters.
full: Rogues do not win fights by trading blows. They win by arranging for one strike to matter more than everyone else's, and by not being where the retaliation lands. Everything in the class serves that: position, opportunity, and getting out.

Sneak Attack scales relentlessly and needs only an ally nearby or a moment of advantage. Cunning Action makes them the hardest class to catch, Expertise turns two skills into near certainties, and Uncanny Dodge and Evasion mean the trap that was meant to kill them usually does not.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skill proficiencies, or one skill and thieves' tools, and double your proficiency bonus for checks with them. Choose two more at 6th level.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage to a creature you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon when you have advantage, or when an ally of the target is within 5 feet and you do not have disadvantage. The extra damage rises by 1d6 at every odd level, to 10d6 at 19th.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know the secret mix of dialect, jargon and code that hides a message inside an ordinary conversation, and you read the signs and symbols that mark a territory or a safe house.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Take the Dash, Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: Choose the archetype your talents follow. It grants features at 3rd, 9th, 13th and 17th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1. Cannot increase scores above 20. Gained at 4th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 16th and 19th level.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When subjected to an effect allowing a Dexterity save for half damage, take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Blindsense
features.description: While you can hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has advantage against you while you are not incapacitated.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: Turn a missed attack into a hit, or treat a failed ability check as a roll of 20. Recharges on a short or long rest.
